adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, in `handleNewBooking.ts`, appends additional team members’ destination calendars for COLLECTIVE (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`). However, when persisting the booking it still writes only a single relation via `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (handleNewBooking.ts around the shown change). Downstream flows that reconstruct `evt` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (confirm.handler, payments webhooks, paypal webhook, etc. in the diff) wrap that single stored destination calendar into a one-element array, losing the additional calendars. As a result, deferred event creation (e.g., after confirmation/payment) can only create calendar events for the first stored destination calendar, not all intended COLLECTIVE hosts.
